title: MapleStory Classic Thief Leveling Guide
author: Nia Meow
summary: A level 10-30 Thief route covering Assassin and Bandit commitment, LUK and DEX allocation, Lucky Seven or Double Stab SP orders, claws, daggers, and armor.

sections.title: Early commitment
items: Lucky Seven points the character toward Assassin while Double Stab points toward Bandit.
Choose the intended attack before committing SP.

sections.title: Stats and gear
items: LUK drives the build while DEX supports equipment requirements.
Plan claws and throwing stars separately from dagger progression.

sections.title: Level 30
items: Assassin continues the ranged throwing-star route.
Bandit develops the dagger-based melee route.

notes: Structured MPStorys reading edition verified in Chrome on 2026-07-27.
steps: Choose the Assassin or Bandit attack path.
Follow the matching SP and equipment route.
Complete the corresponding second-job advancement at level 30.
